description: This file defines the EncounterDAO interface, which specifies database operations related to Encounter entities in the OpenMRS system, including saving, deleting, retrieving encounters, encounter types, and encounter roles.

classes.name: EncounterDAO
classes.description: An interface defining database access operations for Encounter-related data, including CRUD operations for encounters, encounter types, and encounter roles.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Persists an Encounter object to the database, returning the saved Encounter.

methods.name: deleteEncounter
methods.description: Removes an Encounter object from the database.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Returns all encounters associated with a particular patient ID.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Fetches a list of encounters based on specified search criteria.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Saves or updates an EncounterType in the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounterType
methods.description: Permanently deletes an EncounterType from the database.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its internal ID.

methods.name: getEncounterType (by name)
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its name.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns all encounter types, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Finds encounter types matching a case-insensitive name pattern.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime
methods.description: Fetches the encounterDatetime value currently stored in the database for a specific encounter.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Finds an Encounter by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Finds an EncounterType by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounters (batch search)
methods.description: Retrieves encounters based on a search query, patient ID, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterLocation
methods.description: Gets the Location associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getAllEncounters
methods.description: Returns all encounters for a specified cohort of patients.

methods.name: getCountOfEncounters
methods.description: Counts encounters matching a search string and patient ID, considering whether to include voided encounters.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Fetches encounters associated with a specified visit, optionally including voided encounters.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Persist an EncounterRole object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounterRole
methods.description: Deletes an EncounterRole from the database.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterRole by internal ID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Finds an EncounterRole by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Returns all encounter roles, with an option to include retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterRole by its name.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Retrieves encounters for a patient that are not linked to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters associated with specific visits and a patient, supporting query text and pagination.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts encounters linked to particular visits and a patient.
